title: Polynomial-Time Comparison of Output Lengths
statement: Let $f,g : \{0,1\}^* \to \{0,1\}^*$ be polynomial-time computable functions. The function that maps each bit string $D$ to the one-bit string whose bit is $1$ exactly when $\abs{f(D)} < \abs{g(D)}$ is polynomial-time computable.
